en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of four photographs of modest buildings in a rural or small‑town setting. The upper left image shows a traditional half‑timbered house with a steep tiled roof, arched doorway, benches, and a wooden fence with plants. The upper right image depicts a long, rectangular institutional building (likely a school or factory) with many uniform windows, a flat façade, and a tall brick chimney along a roadside. The lower left view shows a simple rendered residential house with a gabled tiled roof and utility pole nearby. The lower right view focuses on the façade of a low, elongated apartment‑like building with multiple windows and some laundry hanging outside. All scenes include trees and give a mid‑20th‑century central European village impression.
